newsitem.title: FRANCE: Ten civilians killed on Algerian farm.
newsitem.headline: Ten civilians killed on Algerian farm.

text.p: Ten civilians were killed overnight on a farm in Algeria's Blida province, security forces said on Thursday.

A statement carried by the official Algerian news agency APS said the 10 were "assassinated in a cowardly way", a phrase used by Algerian authorities to denote an attack by Moslem militants, with the victims often having their throats slit.
